title: Woman robbed on camera – level 1
paragraphs: This news is from Brazil. A person from a TV show films a woman. She stands on a street. She gives an interview. She talks about crime. Suddenly, something bad happens. A man tries to rob the woman. He wants to take her necklace.
The woman is fine. The man does not steal the necklace. Police come, but they are late. The man is gone. Crime is a problem in the area.
You can read the original story and watch the video in the Level 3 section.
